title: Final Mixed Interview Simulation
prerequisite: Lessons 1–23. Relevant patterns are intentionally not announced.
hints: Part A needs a variable-size window with required multiplicities; Part B needs breadth-first search because each edge has equal cost.
For Part A, count satisfied requirements while expanding and contracting a window. For Part B, process graph nodes in distance layers.
Part A records the shortest valid window while moving left; Part B marks nodes when enqueued and returns the first distance reaching the target.
